definitions.explanation: A piece of furniture with shelves and often glass doors, used to store dishes, glasses, and tableware.

examples.japanese: {食器棚|しょっきだな}から{皿|さら}を{出|だ}してください。
examples.english: Please get the plates from the dish cabinet.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{食器棚|しょっきだな}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a new dish cabinet.

examples.japanese: {食器棚|しょっきだな}の{中|なか}を{整理|せいり}した。
examples.english: I organized the inside of the dish cabinet.

notes:
RELATED FURNITURE:
- {本棚|ほんだな} (bookshelf)
- {靴棚|くつだな} (shoe rack)
- {戸棚|とだな} (cupboard - general)
- {水屋|みずや} (traditional kitchen cupboard)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食器棚|しょっきだな}にしまう (to put away in the cupboard)
- {食器棚|しょっきだな}から{取|と}り{出|だ}す (to take out from the cupboard)
- ガラス{張|ば}りの{食器棚|しょっきだな} (glass-fronted cabinet)

FORMS:
- カップボード (cupboard - loanword, often used for built-in kitchen storage)
- キッチンボード (kitchen board - a combined unit with counter space)
